name: New England Biolabs Foundation local grants (North Shore of Massachusetts)
summary: Small grants for local nature conservation, and for art and culture projects about the environment, in seaside towns north of Boston, Massachusetts.

geography.label: Coastal communities on the North Shore of Massachusetts

reporting: Grantees submit an end-of-project report through the online grant system before the final 20% payment, or an interim report if the project is not finished within the one-year grant period.

status.quote: Our 2026 grant round is now closed.

applicant_types.quote: New England Biolabs Foundation grants are limited to organizations that hold charitable status in their respective countries.

access.quote: The first step in the process is to submit a letter of inquiry (LOI) to us, following the guidelines posted here.

window.quote: Our directors meet twice a year to review proposals, and we inform applicants of funding decisions shortly thereafter.

reporting.quote: The foundation must receive your end of project report upon project completion, or an interim report if your project is incomplete by the end of the one-year grant period.

geography.quote: In support of our local roots, we also provide small grants for community-based conservation and arts and cultural projects in coastal communities on the North Shore of Massachusetts.

amount.quote: Our international grants range from $5,000 to $15,000, and our local grants range from $4,000 to $10,000.
